subject.title: fix(mcp): normalize disabled:true to enabled:false in canonicalizeConfiguredMcpServer

question: Should `mcp.servers.*.disabled` become a supported OpenClaw configuration alias, or should OpenClaw retain only the documented `enabled` field?
rationale: The linked report uses an undocumented field, while repository policy requires one canonical runtime shape and places legacy compatibility in explicit migrations; code review cannot establish that product contract.

options.title: Keep enabled canonical
options.body: Remove the new schema alias and either reject `disabled` with actionable guidance or add a doctor migration only if shipped legacy provenance is found.

options.title: Support disabled alias
options.body: Normalize the alias on every raw config ingestion path, always remove it from canonical state, document precedence, and prove fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep enabled canonical
recommendation.body: Remove the new schema alias and either reject `disabled` with actionable guidance or add a doctor migration only if shipped legacy provenance is found.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent MCP scope and canonical-registry decisions make steipete the strongest available routing candidate for this config-surface choice.
